depth_targets.title: Key rotation (rotation period + manual Rotate key)
limitations: The rotation period and next rotation time are stored and returned exactly as configured, but Vyomi has no background scheduler — it never rotates a key on its own.

"Rotate key" creates a new primary CryptoKeyVersion for real, but every version of a CryptoKey shares the same underlying key material in Vyomi (there is no per-version crypto); rotating is a bookkeeping change, not a new encryption key.

depth_targets.title: Key versions (create, make primary, enable, disable, destroy, restore)
limitations: Version state is enforced for Encrypt (it fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION unless the primary version is ENABLED), but Decrypt does not re-check the state of the version that originally produced a ciphertext — only the CryptoKey itself must still exist.

depth_targets.title: Permissions (IAM policy on a key)
limitations: getIamPolicy/setIamPolicy store and return the policy exactly as written, but Vyomi does not evaluate it — it never denies or allows a KMS call based on policy content.

depth_targets.title: Autokey (automatic per-resource key ring/key provisioning)
limitations: Autokey provisions key rings and keys automatically when a resource is created, gated by an organization/folder policy and a dedicated key project. Vyomi doesn't model org policy or cross-project key provisioning, so there is nothing to wire this to.
